privacy.scope: Normalized paths may merge unrelated origins or identifiers. Evidence is incomplete; no route was requested or verified by this tool.

har_body_analysis.scope: Body coverage only: missing text does not establish an empty body. JSON shapes discard all values and may be sampled. Form fields count names per entry, not values or types. Multipart text and uploaded file data are never inspected. Counts cover all entries; body records are bounded.
